rules.statement: The burden of proof rests fairly and squarely on the party invoking the provisions of Section 3 of the Prescription to establish a starting point for their acquisition of prescriptive rights.
rules.supporting_quote: Where a party invokes the provisions of Section 3 of the Prescription, the burden of proof rests fairly and squarely on him to establish a starting point for his or her acquisition of prescriptive rights [Chelliah v. Wijenathan et al (54 N.L.R. 337)].
